Shipping

Do you ship internationally?

Yes — to 40 countries, with tracking on every order.

How long does delivery take?

2–4 business days in the US, 5–10 days abroad.

Can I change my address?

Until the order ships, from your account page.

Billing

Which payment methods do you accept?

All major cards, plus:

  • Apple Pay and Google Pay
  • Bank transfer for annual plans
Can I get an invoice?

Yes. Every payment emails a PDF invoice, and all invoices are in Billing.

Do you offer refunds?

Within 30 days, no questions asked.

Account

How do I reset my password?

Use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.

Can I have several users?

Team plans include up to 10 seats.

How do I delete my account?

Settings → Account → Delete. It takes effect immediately.
